body:
The highlighting mechanism is implemented in [node_3d_editor_gizmos.cpp](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/master/editor/plugins/node_3d_editor_gizmos.cpp)'s `add_handles` method(line 438:444), which tries to highlight/tint handle svg in blue(`Color(0, 0, 1, 0.9)`) and doesn't work right now.
This could be because `is_handle_highlighted(id, p_secondary)` is never true.
My proposed solution to this issue is to use the existing detection mechanism for non-hovering handles, and add an else statement to achieve the blue tine as intended in original code.

I managed to make the feedback cleaner by using a blue with an alpha of 0.5.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/d1911e22-ada8-447d-b430-b6e67beda248

I'm working on solving this issue, please share your thoughts!
